import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def acceptance_completion_plot(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7.7, 7), constrained_layout=True)
    points = ax.scatter(df.acceptance_order, df.completion_order,
        c=df.pending_count_before_completion, cmap='viridis', s=82,
        edgecolor='white', linewidth=.7)
    fig.colorbar(points, ax=ax, label='Pending tasks before completion')
    ax.set(xlabel='Task acceptance order', ylabel='Task completion order',
        title='Completion order frequently departs from acceptance order',
        xlim=(0, len(df)+1), ylim=(0, len(df)+1))
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.grid(alpha=.2)
    ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    print(df[['acceptance_order', 'completion_order']].corr(method='spearman'))

acceptance_completion_plot(df)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def priority_plot(df, index):
    d = df.sort_values('completion_order').copy()
    if index == 1:
        q = d[d.pending_count_before_completion >= 9]
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 5.5), constrained_layout=True,
            gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [2.4, 1]})
        x = np.arange(len(d))
        low_positions = x[d.pending_count_before_completion.to_numpy() < 9]
        if len(low_positions):
            axes[0].axvspan(low_positions.min()-.5, low_positions.max()+.5,
                color='#e8edf2', zorder=0)
            axes[0].text(float(low_positions.mean()), 25.5, 'Low backlog (≤8)\nContext only',
                ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9, color='#536170')
        axes[0].scatter(x-.12, d.acceptance_rank_among_pending, color='#c77c3d',
            marker='s', s=65, label='Acceptance rank: 1 = oldest pending task')
        axes[0].scatter(x+.12, d.proximity_rank_among_pending, color='#4f846c',
            s=65, label='Road-distance rank: 1 = nearest destination')
        axes[0].set(xticks=x, xticklabels=d.pending_count_before_completion,
            xlabel='Pending tasks at each successive decision', ylabel='Rank of selected task',
            title='Complete decision sequence: high to low backlog', xlim=(-.6,len(d)-.4),
            ylim=(0, 29), yticks=[1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 24])
        axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=9)
        axes[0].legend(loc='upper left', frameon=False, fontsize=9)
        rates = [(q.proximity_rank_among_pending == 1).mean(),
                 (q.acceptance_rank_among_pending == 1).mean()]
        counts = [int((q.proximity_rank_among_pending == 1).sum()),
                  int((q.acceptance_rank_among_pending == 1).sum())]
        axes[1].bar(['Selected nearest', 'Selected oldest'], rates, color=['#4f846c', '#c77c3d'])
        for i, rate in enumerate(rates):
            axes[1].text(i, rate+.03, f'{counts[i]}/{len(q)} ({rate:.1%})', ha='center')
        axes[1].set(ylim=(0, 1.05), ylabel='Share of decisions', title=f'{len(q)} decisions with ≥9 pending tasks')
        axes[1].yaxis.set_major_formatter(lambda v, _: f'{v:.0%}')
        evidence = dict(high_age_median=float(q.acceptance_rank_among_pending.median()),
            high_proximity_median=float(q.proximity_rank_among_pending.median()),
            high_pending_decisions=len(q), nearest_selected_count=counts[0], oldest_selected_count=counts[1])
    else:
        # One remaining task offers no prioritization choice; exclude it.
        d = d[d.pending_count_before_completion > 1].copy()
        d['normalized_age_rank'] = (d.acceptance_rank_among_pending-1)/(d.pending_count_before_completion-1)
        labels = ['Low (2–8)', 'Medium (9–16)', 'High (17–24)']
        d['band'] = pd.cut(d.pending_count_before_completion, [1, 8, 16, 24], labels=labels)
        stats = d.groupby('band', observed=True).normalized_age_rank.agg(['mean', 'count'])
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.7, 5.4), constrained_layout=True)
        axes[0].scatter(d.pending_count_before_completion, d.normalized_age_rank,
            s=65, color='#3976a8', edgecolor='white')
        axes[0].set(xlabel='Pending tasks before completion',
            ylabel='Normalized acceptance rank (0 = oldest, 1 = newest)',
            title='Lower backlog favors earlier-accepted tasks', ylim=(-.03, 1.08))
        axes[1].bar(labels, stats['mean'], color=['#4f846c', '#3976a8', '#c77c3d'])
        for i, row in enumerate(stats.itertuples()):
            axes[1].text(i, row.mean+.025, f'{row.mean:.3f}\nn={row.count}', ha='center')
        axes[1].set(ylabel='Mean normalized acceptance rank (lower = older)',
            title='Backlog groups; single-task case excluded', ylim=(0, 1))
        evidence = dict(mean_normalized_age_rank_by_backlog=stats['mean'].round(3).to_dict(),
            high_minus_medium_mean=round(float(stats.loc[labels[2], 'mean']-stats.loc[labels[1], 'mean']), 3),
            low_pending_age_rank_median=float(d[d.pending_count_before_completion <= 8].acceptance_rank_among_pending.median()),
            excluded_single_task_decisions=1)
    for ax in axes:
        ax.set_axisbelow(True); ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=.2)
        ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    print(evidence)
    return evidence

evidence = priority_plot(df, 1)
plt.show()

insights: The courier does not consistently complete pending tasks in the order in which they were accepted.
When many tasks are pending at the same time, completion order is more strongly organized by destination proximity than by task age.
As the number of pending tasks decreases, the courier's completion order becomes more closely aligned with the tasks' acceptance order.
summary: The route is not first-in-first-out. With a large queue, the courier usually selects one of the nearest destinations even when that task is relatively new; after the backlog falls, selected tasks are much more often among the oldest still pending.
